test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the related word from the given alternatives

Ornithology : Birds :: Paleontology : ?
solution:
The relationship provided in the first part of the analogy is "field of study : subject of study" (Ornithology is the study of Birds). 

 
• Applying this same relationship, Paleontology is the field of study dedicated to the examination of fossils

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
